summary: MaintProgramProfileDetails and related files together establish the workflow, business rules, and field behaviors for viewing and editing a program's administrative profile, program description, document management, invoice rates, student/instructor access, and profile history within an academic institution's management system.
purpose: Enable authorized users to manage, update, and review program profiles, including contact information, logo/address handling, prerequisites, document uploads, invoicing, and access controls for students and instructors.

workflows.name: Edit Program Profile Details
steps: User selects program for editing.
FormView is populated with program details.
User edits fields including display name, contact info, logo/address controls.
Checkboxes for prerequisites, documents, access, etc. are set; captions and controls are updated according to configuration and student access settings.
Student access rows are hidden/shown depending on AllowStudentAccess flag.
User clicks save; ProgramProfileUpdate is invoked.

workflows.name: Manage Program Description
steps: GridView lists program descriptions by sort order.
User can add/edit/delete descriptions.
Sort order and response fields are managed.
Changes trigger redirect with cache update.

workflows.name: Program Profile History
steps: History GridView loads using ProgramID and SessionAgencyID.
History displayed for review; selection tied to session context.

workflows.name: Program Document Management
steps: GridView lists program documents.
User can add/edit/delete documents.
User uploads files, which are validated and stored with unique paths.
Certain document types (e.g., LOGO) have special handling and cannot be duplicated.
Document uploads update file system and URLs; changes trigger redirect.

workflows.name: Manage Invoice Rates
steps: GridView lists invoice rates per placement type.
User can add/edit/delete invoice rate rows.
Fields include start date, rate, unit, instructor led.
Rates validated on insert/update.

workflows.name: Student Access Configuration
steps: User sets student access for profile features.
Rows are hidden if access is not enabled.
Special caption logic for checkboxes (e.g., student already allowed).

workflows.name: Instructor Access Configuration
steps: User sets instructor access to course, term, and student history/features via checkboxes.
Programs.ProgramUpdateJustFlags invoked on save.

business_rules: Checkbox captions reflect underlying state (YES/NO, student already allowed).
If student access to certain features is allowed, disable checkbox and change appearance.
Logo document type cannot be duplicated if already in use.
Email mask fields are only available for SysAdmin role.
Document uploads validate file type; reject 32-bit CMYK JPEG.
GridView add/edit/delete buttons are enabled only if screen is editable.
Invoice rates use currency format; rates are parsed and validated upon entry.
validations: Phone mask logic enforced depending on UserSession.UsePhoneMask.
File uploads checked for JPEG type, file size, and uniqueness.
Required fields in forms enforced via validators.
Email mask input visibility based on role.
calculations: Invoice rate parsing and conversion from TextBox using Decimal.TryParse with currency style.
SortOrder conversion and defaulting (-1 if empty).
conditions: Student access rows hidden if AllowStudentAccess is false.
Email mask fields hidden if UserSession.RoleName != 'SysAdmin'.
Logo code removal from drop-downs if department logo is in use or exists.
Only editable screens allow add/edit/delete operations.
system_behavior: Redirects after save/update to maintain context and update cache.
JavaScript variables setup based on screen context and configuration.
File uploads stored in unique folders; URLs generated for access.
Data-bound event handlers adjust field visibility and logic.
dependencies: Program and related entities depend on UserSession for context.
StaffController for invoice contact lookup and update.
Resources for UI strings and validation messages.
exceptions: File upload error if 32-bit CMYK JPEG detected.
Cancel event triggers redirect without saving.
Invalid or missing UserSession cancels data selection.
content_gaps: No detailed field definitions for each profile feature (e.g., documents, certifications).
No explicit UI layouts or screen mockups.
External dependencies (e.g., StaffController, Programs, Codes) are referenced but not explained in detail.
